effect.name: Shockwave
effect.description: An expanding ring that bends whatever it passes over. The explosion effect: pair it with a white flash and a screen shake and a small hit turns into an event.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Centre X
parameter.description: Centre of the ring across the object, 0 is the left edge and 1 the right.

parameter.name: Centre Y
parameter.description: Centre of the ring down the object.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: Current size of the ring, where 1 is half the object's width. Animate this.

parameter.name: Ring Width
parameter.description: How thick the disturbed band is.

parameter.name: Strength
parameter.description: How far the ring pushes pixels, in texels. Negative pulls inward.

parameter.name: Highlight
parameter.description: Brightens the crest of the ring so it reads even against flat colour.
